title: Lyra 2.0: Explorable Generative 3D Worlds
summary: Developed by NVIDIA's Spatial Intelligence Lab, Lyra 2.0 generates persistent and explorable 3D environments from a single image. It utilizes a per-frame 3D geometry memory to maintain spatial consistency during long-horizon navigation.
research_notes: Integrates with NVIDIA Isaac Sim for embodied AI training; includes an interactive GUI for camera path planning and real-time world exploration.

evolution.summary: Succeeds the original Lyra model, evolving from feed-forward reconstruction to a retrieve-generate-update loop for continuous world generation. It introduces self-augmented training to prevent temporal drift and supports high-fidelity 3D Gaussian Splatting exports.
